correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Straub–Moll–Amdeberhan known pointwise valuation carry theorem using binary digits of 3^(-1) with alternating 0,1. Carry transition at b=0 has E(u)=[[2,0],[1,u]], at b=1 O(u)=[[1,u],[0,2u]], so pair T=EO=[[2,2u],[1,u+2u²]], trace 2+u+2u² determinant 4u². The even terminal vector (1,1) and distinct odd terminal (1,u) yield precisely the two rational generating functions by (I-zT)^(-1). Differentiation at u=1 gives exact means; Perron eigenvalue 4 with second eigenvalue1, derivative log λ(e^t) at zero 1, second derivative 4/3, prove variance slope and CLT by analytic perturbation. Input-digit constraints determine sharp maximum and zero frequencies. Independent exact arithmetic checked all 4096 first coefficients, carry counts, transfer formula and symbolic rational functions. No finite sample is used to deduce the CLT.
